description.zh:
告警名称：
- ALL：全部告警
敏感文件告警中用于加白判定的字段。
description.en: Field used for whitelist in sensitive file alerts.
Expected value of the field to be whitelisted.

description.zh:
规则判定操作符：
- strEqual：字符串相等
description.en:
Rule judgment operator:
- strEqual: String equals

description.zh:
业务来源：
- agentless：无代理检测

生效目标类型：
- ALL：全部资产
- SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
description.en:
Effective target type:
- ALL: All assets
- SELECTION_KEY: Assets selected via the asset selection component

description.zh:
目标生效范围：
- ALL：全部资产
- 其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
description.en:
Target effective scope:
- ALL: All assets
- Other: Key of the asset range selected by the asset selection component

title.zh: 创建无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
title.en: Create Sensitive File Alert Whitelist Rule of Agentless Detection

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-malicious-file-whitelist-config --event-name ALL --field fileMd5 --operator strEqual --field-value b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --target-type ALL --target-value ALL --source agentless --remark whitelist --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Operator strEqual --Field fileMd5 --TargetValue ALL --TargetType ALL --EventName ALL --FieldValue b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --Source agentless --Remark whitelist
